title: OJ Assistant account configuration
description: Configuration for one account workspace. Credentials are migrated to VS Code SecretStorage; only non-sensitive values stay in this file.

backend.description: Platform adapter id. Readable aliases such as hduoj / hnu-acm / hnu-cg are accepted.

baseUrl.description: Override the platform base URL (for mirrors or self-hosted deployments).

credentials.description: Sensitive fields (password, cookies, token, secret, apiKey) are moved to SecretStorage automatically.

cookies.description: Cookie header harvested by the browser login command.

credentialRef.description: Managed by the extension; identifies the SecretStorage entry.

preferredLanguage.description: Platform language id chosen in the panel; overrides the submission picker.

askLanguage.description: Ask which platform language to use when submitting. Set false to use the first match.

languages.description: Source extension (or platform language key) -> platform language value.

pathParseRule.description: Regular expressions that map a source file path to a problem id.

translation.description: Problem-statement translation providers. 'auto' tries the configured chain.

webLoginTimeout.description: Seconds to wait for the browser login to complete.

captchaAttempts.description: Automatic captcha retry count for username/password login (CSECG / NEU OJ).

submitBody.description: Optional submit-body template with {id} {contestId} {langId} {code} placeholders (NEU OJ).

endpoints.description: Optional endpoint overrides for self-hosted deployments.
